_comment: PROVISIONAL. Hand-written from known Apple Silicon + MoltenVK facts (Vulkan 1.2.268, VK_KHR_portability_subset, VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering, no logicOp / wideLines / geometryShader / shaderFloat64). Rebuild from real Mac Round 1 vulkaninfo before relying on exact limits or format support. SIMULATE_FORMATS_BIT is intentionally NOT enabled in tools/run-apple-profile.ps1 because this provisional file omits a complete VkFormat feature table. Note: khronos_profiles.emulate_portability requires Vulkan SDK < 1.4.363; on 1.4.363+ the profile still simulates API 1.2.268 and missing logicOp/wideLines/geometryShader/shaderFloat64.

VP_VOOLKAN_APPLE_M.label: voolkan Apple Silicon / MoltenVK (provisional)
